editorial.name: Fabric
editorial.descriptionZh: 把文件、笔记、想法、会议收进一个空间，再配一个记得住这些内容的 AI：能查、能写、能把整个空间发布成给客户看的页面。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把文件笔记会议丢进一个 AI 工作台并发布成页
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是大段留白加一行 4.7 星与 3K+ app ratings，然后衬线大字 A personal AI that actually knows you，按钮 Try for $0。往下能看到几个具名的 AI 助手在做事：Sol 读周末笔记并把三张 Linear ticket 挪进本周，Juno 用 Ezra 的语气写好客户回信留在 Gmail 草稿，Pip 读会议记录更新 roadmap，Mochi 把散笔记变成文章大纲。功能块里有 An infinite canvas、Meeting notes that write themselves、Share beautifully with clients（可设密码、免登录、带 link analytics），最后按 Founders / Students / Designers / Researchers 分角色给入口。

reasons.statement: 产出物是笔记、文档、项目空间与可对外发布的 client portal（Publish any space as a polished portal for clients, stakeholders, or new hires），属内容与呈现物料生成。
分类有不确定性：页面同时强调 An infinite canvas 与 kanban 任务管理，也可读作 ui-prototyping-whiteboard；此处按用户最直接拿到的是可发布的内容空间来定。

pages.title: Fabric — the AI workspace that thinks with you
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

shot.alt: Fabric 首屏：A personal AI that actually knows you

facts.value: 内置具名 AI 助手 Sol、Juno、Pip、Mochi、Ada，分别被描述为处理笔记、起草客户回信、更新 roadmap、整理大纲与拼 moodboard
facts.evidence: 正文 An AI that actually knows you. 段下五条示例，如 Sol (AI) read Leo's weekend notes and moved three Linear tickets into this week.、Mochi (AI) turned Ana's scattered notes into the essay outline she was avoiding.。

facts.value: 任一空间可发布成免登录的对外页面，支持密码保护与链接访问分析
facts.evidence: 正文 Publish any space as a polished portal for clients, stakeholders, or new hires. No login required. Just a link.、Password protect any shared space, folder, or file. 与 Understand engagement with link analytics.。

facts.value: 首屏标称 50+ integrations，另有 marketplace 收录连接与模板
facts.evidence: 首屏标签行 Search everything / 50+ integrations / Publish anything / Memory that grows / Multiplayer / Agents that work for you，站内路径含 /marketplace/connections、/marketplace/templates。
